title: 2022 HMMT November Guts Problem 9
statement: Let \(A B C D\) be a trapezoid such that \(A B \| C D, \angle B A C=25^{\circ}, \angle A B C=125^{\circ}\), and \(A B+A D=C D\). Compute \(\angle A D C\).

solutions.text:
Construct the parallelogram \(A B E D\). From the condition \(A B+A D=C D\), we get that \(E C=A D=E B\). Thus,

\[\angle A D C=\angle B E C=180^{\circ}-2 \angle B C E=180^{\circ}-2 \cdot 55^{\circ}=70^{\circ} .\]
